events.summary: 🎣 NEW: FISHING Fishing is here! events.title: Farm & Feast Demo Patch Notes v0.1.5
events.summary: ☕ Coffee Stand Are guests losing patience while the kitchen is busy? Bring them a hot coffee and their Patience Bar freezes for a while. Coffee costs a few coins to brew and earns no profit, so pour it only when you need to. When the pot runs out, the chefs brew a fresh one on their own. It unlocks on Day 5 with a short tutorial. 🍰 Dessert Stand Served a dish late or made a mistake? Give your guests a dessert while they're eating, before they ask for the bill, to raise their rating. events.title: 🌿 The Farm & Feast Demo is Officially LIVE! Welcome to Your Cozy Restaurant!
events.summary: Hey everyone! zbeedev and arttec here! After months of hard work, we are beyond thrilled to announce that the Farm & Feast demo is now officially live on Steam! As a two-person core indie team, we wanted to create a low-stakes, relaxing world where you can escape the daily stress.
